mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 74 degrees feeling like 78, and the moon is currently in its first quarter phase.

City news highlights ongoing infrastructure improvements, specifically the Mark Drive reconstruction project which includes new water mains and sidewalks, alongside general street rehabilitation projects planned for 2026.
We have a busy schedule with the Downtown Farmer's Market today at Hometown Junction Park, and tomorrow you can catch Concerts in the Park at Century School Park.
Regarding recent activity, on August 15, officers conducted a traffic stop where they arrested a 44-year-old woman for O W I after she was found asleep in her vehicle.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Double Strawberry. Culver's is open until 10 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
